correctness.rationale: The unnormalized XOR convolution is diagonal on all 45-edge characters, with one summand per unoriented simple octagon. The independent enumeration projects onto four distinct synthemes with successive intersections equal to four distinct duads, and chooses one cyclic orientation and base per cycle. It finds 90 distinct octagons, 16 uses of each edge, and no smaller cycle. The incidence graph is connected: disjoint duads share a syntheme, and two intersecting duads have a third duad disjoint from both. Switching is addition of a cut and fixes all cycle evaluations, hence each switching class has 2^29 frequencies. An independent binary row reduction of the 45-by-90 incidence matrix finds rank 16, so the evaluation image is precisely one word per switching class. Enumerating the image in Gray order and binning by 90−2 times Hamming weight reproduces all eighteen levels and multiplicities. The even edge incidence makes every codeword even weight and every multiplier 2 mod 4. In the original BFS convention cotree mask 85 attains −2; the trivial character attains 90. Fourier diagonalization therefore gives full range, inverse norm 1/2 and condition number 45 for the stated normalization.
residual_risks: The spectrum is of Boolean edge-space convolution, not the adjacency spectrum of the 30-vertex graph. The multiplicities in the table must be multiplied by 2^29 in the full space.

checked_sources: Frozen Finding and convolution proof; independent rank and signed enumeration; known octagon count and cycle geometry
value.rationale: The Tutte–Coxeter graph is the natural cubic girth-eight cage, and its shortest cycles define a canonical support for recovery by convolution. The spectrum determines the complete cancellation distribution and sharp stability on the full Boolean edge space, beyond the unsigned cycle count or the parity-based nonsingularity alone. It also provides the exact weight enumerator of the associated short-cycle evaluation code, which can be used independently for comparisons with parallel cage constructions.
residual_risks: No family-wide spectral law or symbolic count of the eighteen multiplicities is proved.
